summary.text: David Rogers is the Democratic candidate for Missouri House of Representatives District 102 in the November 3, 2026 general election, in which he faces incumbent Richard West (R).
In a Ballotpedia survey, he described himself as a 14-year UAW member who has lived in St. Charles since 2019.

paragraphs.text: According to Ballotpedia, David Rogers graduated from Niles McKinley High School and earned a bachelor's degree from Youngstown State University in 2010, and his profession is listed as laborer.
In a Ballotpedia survey, he described himself as a husband, father and brother.

Rogers said in the survey that legislators should take the will of the voters seriously, that government should protect rights including a safe work environment, healthcare access, housing availability and freedom of expression, and that public dollars should go to public goods.
He listed good governance, public education, healthcare freedom and workers' rights as the policy areas he is most passionate about.
